result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock left. The fix is a one-line filter in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 1491), where the query now adds `AND s.quantity > 0`. It matches the other stock overviews. The per-warehouse quantity lookup is a separate query and still returns 0 for products with no row, so it is unaffected.

I also added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft` to `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`. It sets screws and nuts in WH-1 to zero, then checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" and that the WH-1 nut quantity is 0. The full offline suite passes, and `StockOverviewTest` reports 4 tests with no failures.

I did not commit.
